1 طَحَّهُ , aor.
طَحُ3َ , (S, O,) inf. n. طَحٌّ, (S, O, K,) He scraped it with his heel so as to remove its superficial part; grazed it with his heel: (S, O, K: *) or he put his heel upon it and then so scraped it. (TA.) ―
-b2- And He spread it, or expanded it. (IDrd, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
